name: WarMUX
notes: WarMUX (trunk after 11.04.1), the turn-based worm battle game, for AmigaOS 3.2+/GFOS: one 68040 soft-float program on GFOpenGPU's SDL 2 modules (the modules need an FPU, so the Installer asks for one). Single-computer play only (against the computer or friends taking turns); no network play in this build. Built from main 04b32fe1 on os32-gcc16-open9.
